commandsAndEvidence: Reviewed all 14 PR #68 changed paths and complete patch.

Inspected Worker D validator, regressions, dependency status, runtime candidate matrix, fixture specification, packaging readiness contract, claim boundary, evidence manifest, Test Center registration, workflow, and source manifest.
Verified Stage 2 workflow runs 31029884183, 31029884035, and 31029884073 are concluded success.
Inspected Ubuntu Stage 1 job log 92378362265 and Ubuntu Stage 2 job log 92387585477, including exact checkout commits.

findings.detail: The Worker D workflow does not set actions/checkout ref to the pull-request head SHA and does not assert git rev-parse HEAD against the claimed source candidate. Stage 1 run 31027132933 is recorded as evidence for e7dee26404a11f076206251f619bfc3f9078753c / 27a2d09ed4ed1d61775a74bccd6eac5aa4b739c6, but Ubuntu job 92378362265 checked out synthetic merge commit 8bfce846a24c188c25dfe15ea02606567e9d2270. Stage 2 run 31029884183 is recorded for 7eecc840f68ca0dff13ab58c138845593254e390 / 2080824a34956e3b202126a0a9bd61b4d645d338, but Ubuntu job 92387585477 checked out synthetic merge commit 40aaf8dc784c50f9111704e8751f5f4bb2398002. The run metadata head_sha is the source SHA, but the tested Git tree is not the claimed source tree. Therefore the source-exact validation and evidence binding claims are not established.
requiredChanges: Change the bounded validation workflow to derive CANDIDATE_SHA from github.event.pull_request.head.sha (or github.sha for push/workflow_dispatch).
Pass ref: ${{ env.CANDIDATE_SHA }} to actions/checkout and assert git rev-parse HEAD equals CANDIDATE_SHA.
Record and verify the actual checked-out tree against the claimed candidate tree.
Run tri-platform source validation on the exact branch commit without rewriting frozen Stage 1/Stage 2 history; use a new validation/evidence candidate when needed.
Refresh evidence that currently binds the source SHA/tree to the synthetic-merge runs, regenerate governed manifest state through canonical owners, and request a fresh Worker J review.
findings.title: Exact-source CI evidence is bound to source SHAs but executed synthetic merge commits

verifiedStrengths: P3-001 remains explicitly blocked by P1-012 review and P2-004 measurement/architecture dependencies.
No browser runtime, sessions, actions, profiles, downloads, uploads, Web Studio, platform support, release, production, or GA support is claimed.
Fixture specifications are deterministic, bounded, local-only, and deny external network access.
Runtime candidates remain unselected and measurements remain SOURCE_DERIVED, BLOCKED, or NOT_RUN rather than promoted.
Canonical Test Center result domains, PARTIAL certification, SOURCE_FOUNDATION support, and supportPromotion=false are preserved.
The validator is non-mutating and rejects identity placeholders, checksum drift, duplicate identities, and claim inflation.
